configuration.search: exact inner-product (isolates model quality from index approximation)

limitations: Computed from the licensed MIND dataset, which this repository does not redistribute, so these numbers cannot be reproduced from a public clone without supplying the dataset locally.
Public CI verifies wiring against synthetic artifacts only; it does not reproduce any number in this report.
Post-selection development evaluation: the content-aware item tower was developed after observing validation behaviour, so this is not an untouched final generalization estimate.

metric_definitions.catalog_coverage_at_n: share of the catalog appearing across all recommendations
metric_definitions.hit_rate_at_n: share of impressions whose clicked item appears in the top N
metric_definitions.mrr: mean reciprocal rank of the first clicked item
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_n: normalised discounted cumulative gain over the top N
metric_definitions.recall_at_n: share of an impression's clicked items appearing in the top N
